name: Cafe Orders
description: Let people order from their phone. Share the frame's link and anyone can open the menu, build an order, leave a name and send it — no account, no app. Behind the counter the same frame is an order board: new orders arrive live, and staff move each one through making, ready and collected. The menu is yours to edit, items can be marked sold out mid-rush, and you can close ordering with one switch when the kitchen is under water. Payment is optional: by default people pay when they collect, and if you connect a Stripe capability the frame will take card payment on Stripe's own hosted checkout instead — card details never touch this frame or your devices. Orders live in an encrypted LocalTable scoped to the placement; the owner can move them to a shared space table.
